record.field: How to find the right Odoo user-documentation guide: call odoo_model_guide_retriever() for a grouped overview, narrow with query="...", then fetch a body by its <app>-<subtopic> code.

This addon ships ~118 guides converted from the Odoo 19 user documentation, one topic each, covering how to use the standard Odoo applications (Sales, Finance, Inventory & Manufacturing, HR, Marketing, Productivity, Websites, Services, Studio, plus Essentials and General).
How to find the right guide 1. Call odoo_model_guide_retriever() with no arguments. It returns a compact grouped overview — one line per application (code + guide_count). This is a cheap first round-trip; do not dump every guide at once. 2. Narrow with a search: odoo_model_guide_retriever(query="sales") returns the matching guides' code, title and summary. Use the summary (the topic's opening paragraph) to judge relevance. 3. Fetch one guide's full body with odoo_model_guide_retriever(code="<code>").
Code naming convention - <app> overview of one application (e.g. sales, finance, hr) - <app>-<subtopic> one area inside it (e.g. sales-crm, finance-accounting) - <app>-<subtopic>-N part N of a large area (e.g. finance-accounting-3) The applications are: essentials, general, sales, finance, inventory_and_mrp, hr, marketing, productivity, services, websites, studio.
Tips - When unsure which sub-guide you need, start from the bare <app> overview code. - query matches code/title/keyword/summary (case-insensitive substring), so query="invoice" also finds topics whose title does not literally contain it. - The retriever's dynamic description lists the application keywords; get the grouped overview first, then narrow with query before fetching bodies.
